attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 4.2.7 cluster on Alpine 3.23, created the payments vhost with an application user (appuser) holding full permissions, declared a durable quorum queue "orders" replicated across all 3 nodes, and proved message durability/consumability by publishing a persistent message and successfully consuming it from node2 while node1 was down. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol for all three nodes, verifying changed boot IDs and full cluster/quorum recovery after each restart.
